note: NECO Marketing round 2 (Round 18 lift): product topics new to the bank (decline stage, convenience/specialty/impulse goods, private label, line depth, test marketing), pricing (competition-based, price war, bundling, prestige, quantity discount, inelastic demand), place (zero-level channel, agents never owning goods, intensive distribution), promotion (prospecting, AIDA, buy-one-get-one-free, reminder advertising, sponsorship, media choice by audience), consumer behaviour (need recognition, loyalty, trusted friends, perceived risk, joint family decisions), research (NBS secondary data, leading questions, sampling, pilot study, internal records) and digital (conversion rate, search ads, content marketing, social-media care, opt-in email). Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the JAMB Commerce marketing items.
